svg.title: Figure 02 · Synthetic price and return observations
svg.desc: 1,512 sessions; initial price 100; Mulberry32 seed 5105 and Box–Muller shocks. Five equally sized artificial regimes have specified log-return drift, volatility and AR(1) coefficients. These are teaching data, not market history.
